Hi colleagues,
Memorable rush behind us, one thing is left: shift swaps

Please review the open coverage needs and send any swap offers directly to the desk. Keep the notes brief, include the route and service point, and flag any animal-handling detail that may affect handoff. The records file is current, and we need clean entries for each assignment.

For arrivals, please follow the usual pickup flow and keep the handover calm and orderly. <<FACT F101>> If a transfer issue develops, route it without delay and keep the record trail intact. <<FACT F106>> For Merrowgate, confirm the relief-area access note before any escort is arranged. <<FACT F017>> The cabin team continues to monitor animals during flight, and the senior coordinator will stay with daily service decisions. Every animal should receive patient attention from trained staff, with no gaps in documentation.

Send any change requests through the normal channel and do not leave partial notes in chat. If you are unavailable for a posted duty, state it clearly and keep the message factual. Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady and accurate.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
